definitions.entry: 4H alone: bullish 4H while in cash. Pairs: bullish 4H AND last completed higher-timeframe WT bullish. If the higher timeframe confirms later while 4H remains bullish, entry is then allowed.
definitions.exit: All variants sell on a confirmed 4H bearish crossover. A higher-timeframe bearish turn alone does not trigger an exit.
definitions.timing: Decide at 4H close using only higher candles whose end timestamp is at or before that close; execute at the next available 4H open, never on the signal close.
definitions.costs: Apply identical friction to each buy and sell: 0%, 0.10%, or 0.25% per side. Initial inherited position and final open position are not forced-liquidated or charged entry/exit fees.
definitions.drawdown: Largest peak-to-trough portfolio decline measured at completed 4H closes, including initial capital. Does not capture intrabar drawdown.
definitions.falseSignals: Operational proxy: completed signal-entry trades with a negative net round-trip return. Excludes the inherited initial position and still-open trades; report losses/count, not just number of losses.
definitions.whipsaw: Subset of losing signal trades exited within four 4H bars of entry.
definitions.rebounds: For each 4H green cross with 20 subsequent bars available, label a rebound when close after those 20 bars is at least 5% above the next-bar open. Missed start: cash at that open. Completely missed: no held position during the entire window. Also report windows with nonpositive net strategy returns, and retain 2% and 10% threshold sensitivity. These labels never influence trades.
definitions.sessions: Main daily WT uses Massive adjusted regular-session OHLC released conservatively at 16:00 ET. Existing 4H/8H bars use extended hours. A separate same-window test compares regular and extended daily aggregation.

limitations: Retrospective 2026 comparison, not an untouched prospective holdout or proof of predictive advantage. No rule, threshold or WT parameter was selected by maximizing returns.
The daily archive ends October 16 although intraday history reaches October 19. All variants stop October 16 for a common fully covered period.
Daily regular-session and extended intraday histories are different session definitions; the shorter session-matched sensitivity isolates this issue.
Extended-hours opens are idealized fills. Friction scenarios do not model varying spreads, market impact, liquidity, dividends, taxes or cash interest. SOXL leverage is embedded in its price series.
Rebound windows can overlap and are descriptive event counts, not independent statistical trials. A missed start may be entered later; complete misses are shown separately.
TradingView candle alignment and numerical equivalence remain unverified. Only fully completed stored bars are used.
